summary: Completed testing of comprehensive Settings page with left sidebar menu and WYSIWYG editor. Settings page structure is correctly implemented with accordion sections and System Messages WYSIWYG editor is fully functional with TipTap.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin, Support, and SEO Dashboard accordion sections are not clickable due to overlay interception

integration_issues.issue: Session expires frequently requiring re-login when navigating to settings pages

passed_tests: Settings page loads with correct left sidebar menu structure
Developer Settings section displays all 4 items (non-accordion): General Settings, Email/SMTP, Custom Code, System Messages
System Messages page loads with message list (5 messages)
System Messages WYSIWYG editor opens when clicking a message
WYSIWYG editor has comprehensive toolbar with formatting options (Bold, Italic, Underline, Heading 1, Heading 2, etc.)
TipTap editor content area is present and functional
Message editor dialog opens correctly with form fields
Settings sidebar navigation using data-testid works for System Messages
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix accordion click functionality in Settings sidebar - Admin, Support, and SEO Dashboard sections are not expanding when clicked due to overlay interception issue
